title: Total influence under random restrictions
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\delta$ be any real number. Choose a subset $J$ of coordinates with weight $\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$, and then choose uniformly a sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$; the restriction of $f$ fixes those coordinates to $z$ and leaves the coordinates in $J$ free. The expectation, with these weights and uniform choices, of the total influence of this restricted function is $\delta$ times the total influence of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube
$\delta$ is a real number with no further restriction
